html:
Before you add another Grok Bot, you want a short list you can actually choose from.

So I built GrokBotScout.
It looks through public Grok Bot listings.
It gives you groups of 7, each with an Add link.
You decide which ones to keep.

Try it: https://t.co/Ur3QWSyjo7 pic.twitter.com/hBXVQ65wkB

— Carolina Dill (@CarolinaDill) October 5, 2026
